svg.title: Which exit status does a Bash pipeline return?
svg.desc: A synthetic producer exits with status seven and the final command cat exits successfully. Bash reports zero by default and seven with pipefail. PIPESTATUS contains both stage statuses.

g.text: Which exit status does a Bash pipeline return?
Pipeline returns 0, the final stage's status.
Pipeline returns 7, the last nonzero status.
To see both stages, capture Bash's PIPESTATUS array immediately after the pipeline.
